Name: (AT) Brighterbats Cute Furniture Set
Author: circecil
Description:
[center]This mod adds 5 pieces of cute pink furniture to the game using Alternative Textures!
The base furniture used for these pieces are the Brown Armchair, Double Bed, Oak Tea Table, Oceanic Rug, and 'A Night On Eco-Hill'
The Brown Armchair has three different options, which can be seen by rotating the furniture.[/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/HzJDsk7/167.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿^ Here's how the furniture looks in-game! ^[/center]
